name: agentic-gamedev-pipeline
description: An autonomous bounded game-feature pipeline with full-owner engineering, evidence-only recovery, parallel final review, and in-game QA.

interface.shortDescription: Autonomous bounded engineering, review, and QA.
interface.longDescription: Turns approved feature documents into a production-ready candidate through autonomous bounded Engineer ownership, deterministic revisions, evidence-only recovery, two parallel read-only Reviews, explicit execution gates, and feature-focused runtime QA.
defaultPrompt: Stabilize the product requirements for this game.
Run the bounded development pipeline from approved feature documents.
Run a fresh Engineer pass that completes the full audit scope before batch-fixing every discovered defect.
Recover test-only Review findings without restarting product convergence.
Run two parallel final Reviews and then feature-focused in-game QA.
